remarks: An exceptional two-family residence in the heart of Greenwich, this property seamlessly blends timeless elegance with modern sophistication. The first-floor unit offers 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full baths beneath soaring 9+ foot ceilings, with gleaming hardwood floors throughout. A stunning chef's kitchen features brand-new stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops. The primary suite boasts a luxurious en suite bath and walk-in closet. Additional highlights include a lower level rec room with an extra bedroom and full bath, Generac generator, exterior video surveillance, in-unit washer and dryer, dedicated off-street parking, and storage. The second-floor residence presents three bedrooms and two full baths, thoughtfully updated for refined comfort. A beautifully renovated kitchen showcases sleek finishes and generous cabinetry, while the serene primary suite offers a spa-inspired bath and ample closet space. Sunlight fills every room, enhancing the warm, inviting ambiance. Outside, a manicured yard provides the perfect setting for alfresco dining or gardening. Enjoy access to all Greenwich town parks and premier shopping and dining along Greenwich Avenue. Conveniently located near Interstate 95, Metro-North Railroad, the Merritt Parkway, Boston Post Road, and Westchester County Airport for effortless commuting. Could easily be converted to a single family residence.
